title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Yes, I'll protect the Doctor.

title: Talk 1
original: I can sit down? No... I'm a bodyguard. As a bodyguard, I have to stay vigilant and keep close to my principal... Am I... perhaps being a bother, standing here?

title: Talk 2
original: Spot? I've met him before... No, actually, when my unit passed through the city he was stationed in, he gave me a hand. He probably doesn't remember. It's fine.

title: Talk 3
original: (I'm not sure what the Doctor is doing, but it looks incredible...) Eh? Uh... I-I didn't say anything. Must've been the wind, Doctor.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, you mentioned these just a second ago, so I went and fetched them for you. Umm... I hope I didn't overstep?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Doctor, I'm so sorry. I rushed in alone again on that last mission... I saw someone was wounded, and it felt like the blood surged straight to my head. I forgot your orders and charged on in. I didn't do it on purpose. P-Please don't hate me..

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Umm, Doctor, were you looking for me...? No, I'm not avoiding you, and I definitely don't hate you... It's just that... Sorry, I'm not sure how to put it into words…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: When I was serving in the Sargonian army, everyone hated me, except for one woman. She was kind to me, and we became best friends. But... in the end... she betrayed me. Doctor, I'm lost. How can I bring myself to trust anyone ever again?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: (The Doctor is so kind, speaking so nicely to me, even though I'm such an unlikable whelp. I should be able to trust the Doctor, right?) Oh, Doctor, I'm listening. Yes, you're still my ever-dependable Doctor. The Doctor's enemies are my enemies!

title: Idle
original: (I think I'd like to sneak a peek… at the Doctor's sleeping face.)

title: Onboard
original: (This one looks kind enough, but will this Doctor be as easy to get along with as Amiya says...?) Ah, excuse me, I'm sorry, I-I was spacing out. Operator, codename Heavyrain, reporting in.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Yes, I should be able to reach this level too.

title: Promotion 1
original: (Amiya is here too. Am I getting fired...?) Eh? I'm getting promoted?

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, is it okay if I don't get promoted...? No, everyone is being so kind... I'm a little scared...

title: Added to Squad
original: By your command.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'll do my best.

title: Depart
original: (I mustn't betray the Doctor's high hopes...)

title: Begin Operation
original: Incoming!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm here.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Doctor, your orders, please?

title: Deployment 1
original: Okay.

title: Deployment 2
original: Right here will do.

title: In Battle 1
original: Die.

title: In Battle 2
original: Out of the way!

title: In Battle 3
original: You're in the way!

title: In Battle 4
original: Hmph!

title: 4-star Result
original: Doctor, did I do okay?

title: 3-star Result
original: Doctor, I can still fight.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Doctor, let me go after them.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, I'll cover you from the rear!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Rhodes Island is so big...

title: Tap
original: Ehhh?!

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor?! Please don't scare me...!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, Happy New Year. Since I came to Rhodes Island, you have cared much for me, but you've never expressed gratitude to me. So today, at the very least, I want to sincerely thank you. (Th-There, I said it! I… I didn't mess up, did I?)

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, can I assist you in any way?

title: Birthday
original: (The Doctor is so popular. Would someone of such stature really need a gift from a girl like me…? But I really do want to give one…) Oh, what am I holding? Well, um, it's a gift. Please, accept it! Happy birthday!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: (They're all surrounding the Doctor. That is to be expected, considering the Doctor's popularity… Oh, the Doctor is waving at me. Is there something behind me? Huh, the Doctor is coming over…) Oh, should I join in the festivities…? Alright.
